lessons.title: A little about you · 1
lessons.goal: Būti means “to be”: aš esu (I am), tu esi (you are, informal), jis / ji yra (he / she is), mes esame (we are), jūs esate (you are, plural or polite), jie / jos yra (they are).

steps.title: A little about you · 1
steps.note: Būti means “to be”: aš esu (I am), tu esi (you are, informal), jis / ji yra (he / she is), mes esame (we are), jūs esate (you are, plural or polite), jie / jos yra (they are). Masculine nouns often end in -as or -is; feminine nouns often end in -a or -ė. Ar introduces a yes/no question.
